criteria.text: CI must fail before deployment when any ${VAR:?} required by docker-compose.app.yml or docker-compose.production.yml is not guaranteed in either generated .env.blue or .env.green.
The check derives required keys and generated environment keys from repository artifacts rather than a hard-coded four-variable allowlist, and a focused test proves one-colour drift fails.
The current repository contract passes the new CI check, existing deploy contract tests pass, and no live host, secret, deploy, migration, reindex, push, or paid action is used.
